about_the_game:
Your mission is to monitor live surveillance feeds for a mysterious organization, keeping a close eye on the rooms for any anomalies. Whether it’s furniture moving on its own or something more sinister, you’ll need to report each anomaly by clicking on it and selecting its type or choosing the correct location and description from a menu. With anomalies appearing at random, every moment is unpredictable. Let too many go unnoticed, and the consequences could be deadly. Your objective is simple: survive the night shift from midnight to 6 AM. Stay alert, rely on your memory, and keep your focus, this job isn’t for the faint of heart.

PHOTOREALISTIC GRAPHICS

  • Immerse yourself in stunning, lifelike visuals that make every detail of the surveillance footage feel real.

NORMAL & DARK MODE

  • Switch between lighting modes to suit your preference or enhance visibility during gameplay.

30+ ANOMALIES PER LEVEL

  • Encounter a wide variety of unpredictable anomalies, each with unique behaviors and challenges.

WELL CRAFTED SOUND DESIGN

  • Atmospheric audio cues and immersive sound effects heighten the suspense and keep you on edge.

RANDOM ANOMALY PATTERN

  • No two playthroughs are the same, ensuring a fresh and unpredictable experience every time.

MULTIPLE CCTV ROOMS

  • Monitor different locations simultaneously, testing your multitasking skills.

INTERACTIVE REPORTING SYSTEM

  • File anomaly reports by selecting the correct type and location from a detailed menu.

Are you going to complete your mission? You'll find out in CLAMO.

content_descriptors.notes: The game contains: flashing lights, loud noises, jumpscares.

name: Anomaly Report

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 (2 Gb)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended / Microphone required for full features.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4670 or AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 (6 GB)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended / Microphone required for full features.

short_description: Anomaly Report is a horror game where you monitor live surveillance feeds, identifying anomalies like moving furniture or supernatural entities. Spotting an anomaly requires filing a report detailing its type and location. With observation and memory, you must survive, and uncover hidden secrets.
